entities.title: Replay every score
entities.summary: The server never takes a score from the browser; it replays the game.
entities.context: A browser can send anything; a public table is worthless if scores can be typed in.

options.title: Issue the seed and replay the recorded controls
options.consequences: A replay per submission, and an engine that computes the same bits in every JavaScript engine.

entities.decision: The server issues each game's seed and stores it unused. A submission carries the recorded controls without a seed; the server replays them from the seed it issued, marks the seed used, and stores the scores the replay produced.
entities.rationale: Only what the game really scored can be listed, and each seed only once.

entities.title: One row per pilot
entities.summary: A game with several players enters each named player's own score, in co-op as in versus.
entities.context: Up to nine pilots play one game, and each keeps their own score.
entities.decision: A submission names each player or leaves them out; each named player with points gets a row of their own, keyed by the seed and their index, with the game's mode and number of players beside it.
entities.rationale: Each pilot is ranked on what they scored, and the table shows what kind of game it was.
